title: The West Don’t Rest
subtitle: Cornish grime. Icy bass. No rest.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Rain, distant thunder, crackling pirate radio
lines: From the coast to the estates.

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Seven-thirty, rain beating on the pane,
Camborne in the morning, here we go again!
Redruth to Penzance, got a patch to run,
Boiler's packed up and the day's just begun!
Leak through the ceiling, water down the wall,
Get the right op booked when the customers call!
Damp on the plaster, TIC finds the cold,
Awaab's clock ticking, get the survey told!

lyrics.name: CHORUS
lyrics.note: Huge distorted bass, aggressive crew chant

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Filthy sliding square-wave bass, rolling phonk cowbell

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: DRS flashing, Air Arc on the way,
Ops want a window, customers want today!
Forty thousand homes, that's a serious gig,
And the planning team's keeping the wheels on the rig!
Flagship thirty-one nine, Camborne twenty-seven six,
Different hours, different towns, yeah, I know the little twist!
Same big family, just reading what's online,
Could we get a little love for the Cornwall pay line?

lyrics.name: DJ Rewind
lines: DID HE JUST MENTION THE WAGES?!

lyrics.name: MC
lines: Just doing a bit of market research.

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: Big up the trades, out there in the rain,
Big up the planners keeping order in the game!
Another little problem getting fucking resolved!
We're not superheroes, ain't wearing no cape,
Just chasing appointments and drinking cold tea!
From the Cornish coast to the houses inland,
Good people doing what they fucking well can!

lyrics.name: Bridge
lyrics.note: Cowbell and low sub-bass, slower delivery

lyrics.name: FINAL DROP
lyrics.note: Massive distorted phonk 808 and icy grime synths

lyrics.name: Final Chorus
lines: GOT THE JOBS! GOT THE SKILLS!

lyrics.name: Spoken
lines: LiveWest repairs, how can I help?

artworkAlt: The West Don’t Rest: the hooded Planner FM MC at a rain-soaked Cornish repairs desk, with a stormy coast, icy blue lettering and violet radio equipment.
sleeveNote: Rain on the slate. Bass in the chest. Cornwall on the dial. The west don’t rest.

title: Planner FM: Diary Pressure
subtitle: Opening shift. Volume up.

lyrics.name: Intro
lines: YOU KNOW WHAT TIME IT IS!

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Half-seven login, straight on the screen,
Twenty missed calls and the diary’s obscene!
Leak in the kitchen, boiler’s gone dead,
Oi! Where’s my op? Where’s my slot?
Supervisor’s asking what jobs we got!
Fucking hell, bruv, we’re booking all night!

lyrics.name: Hook
lines: GET THE OP ON THE PHONE!

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Damp on the ceiling, taps gone bust,
Chasing the tradesmen, doing what we must!
Check the fucking notes, know what I mean!
No slots left? Better find a way,
Move that job to another day!
Overdues low, keep the board green,

artworkAlt: Planner FM: Diary Pressure — the hooded MC on the phone at a rain-soaked mixing desk, with a full appointment diary, rooftop speakers and blue graffiti lettering.
sleeveNote: Twenty missed calls. One very full diary. The repairs desk becomes the decks.

title: Three In The Morning
subtitle: After hours. No sleep. Bass deep.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Vinyl crackle, distant thunder, deep distorted voice

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Three-year-old girl, little angel in bed,
Never slept a full night, doing in my head!
Up at one, up at three, up at four,
Little feet coming padding across the floor.
Six-year-old boy, little whirlwind of fun,
Solid as a nut, yeah, that's my son!
Absolute handful, heart made of gold,
Wouldn't swap either for the world, I'm told.

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Clock in at work, eyes half shut,
Another damn job, another fucking rut!
Damp on the ceiling, mould on the wall,
Deadlines ticking and the customers call.
Back through the door, dad mode engaged,
Running on fumes but I'm back on the stage!
Love the little bastards with all of my might!

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: Finally some peace, no kids about.
Headphones on, let the bassline rip,
Roll up a spliff, take a slow little hit.
Smoke for the pain, let the mind unwind,
Another filthy bassline taking shape in my mind.
No sleep, no rest, but I've still got love,
Two little angels and the stars above.

lyrics.name: Outro
lyrics.note: Beat strips back to cowbell and sub
lines: Could do with a fucking kip though.

artworkAlt: 3AM Frequency / No Sleep FM sleeve: the hooded Planner FM MC at a glowing late-night desk between holographic astronaut and fairy children, with a moonlit Cornish coast outside and a Same Shit Tomorrow note.
sleeveNote: Headphones on when the house finally sleeps. Running on love and fumes.

title: Boots On The Ground
subtitle: MST massive. Penzance to Cheltenham.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Deep distorted voice, pirate radio static
lines: But this one ain't about us...
This one's for the ones out there,

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Van full of tools, heading out of town!
Penzance to Cheltenham, covering the patch,
Another front door, another job dispatched!
Up through Gloucestershire, the whole damn crew!
Door won't shut and the tap's gone wrong,
MST turns up, been grafting all along!
Timber cut clean, new tile on the wall,
Brickwork patched, yeah, they handle it all!
We put it on the board, they put it right,
Getting homes sorted from morning till night!

lyrics.name: Pre-Chorus
lyrics.note: Beat strips to cowbell, melodic vocals
lines: From the diary to the driveway,
From the first call to the key...

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Hypnotic phonk cowbell, sliding Eskimo bass

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: No two houses ever quite the same!
Another bit of graft, another day complete!
Can hang a door, make the hinges behave,
Patch up a wall like a master of the trade!
But give him a tablet, watch his confidence slip,
Twenty fucking minutes trying to find 'submit'!
Oi! What's the password? What's this screen?
Why's the bloody thing gone green?!
Call the planners, "This app's gone flat!"
"YOU'VE FIXED THE FUCKING HOUSE, JUST PRESS THAT!"

lyrics.name: DJ REWIND
lines: THEY CAN FIX A FUCKING BUILDING...
BUT THEY CAN'T UPDATE A TABLET!

lyrics.name: Bridge
lines: From the Cornish coast to the northern end,
There's a bloke with a toolbox you can depend on.
Behind every door there's somebody's life,
A little peace of mind when you put something right.
No medals, no headlines, no standing applause,
Just good honest graft for a bloody good cause.

lyrics.name: FINAL DROP
lyrics.note: Massive polished phonk bass, layered gang vocals

lyrics.name: Final Chorus
lines: LET THE WHOLE SOUTH WEST SHOUT!

artworkAlt: MST Massive — Boots On The Ground: the hooded Planner FM MC with a clipboard, surrounded by the South West repairs team, tool-filled vans and a neon Penzance-to-Cheltenham route.
sleeveNote: From the diary to the driveway. Big up the MSTs keeping homes sound, from Penzance to Cheltenham. Just remember to close your jobs.

title: Hold That Line
subtitle: One number. Every problem.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Telephone ringing, distorted Memphis vocal sample

lyrics.name: DROP
lyrics.note: Filthy distorted 808, sinister cowbell, icy square-wave bass

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Queue's going mad, calls keep stacking.
Rent on the line, roof's got a leak,
Next one's a complaint from the other week.
Lost their keys, neighbour's gone mad,
Someone's in tears, someone's proper pissed off.
CSC dealing with the great unknown.
No crystal ball, no magic trick,
Just another bloody problem to pick.
Keep that voice calm, keep it polite,
Even when the caller's looking for a fight.

lyrics.name: Hook
lyrics.note: Dark rhythmic shouted chant, bass cutouts

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: One says the neighbour's threatening their door,
Next one can't take the pain anymore.
Cut the jokes, get serious now,
Find the right support, work out how.
Real fear, real lives, real shit,
Can't solve all that with a button and click.
No fucking script for the weight of a call,
When someone's got their back against the wall.
Then the next one's asking about a parking space,
Back to the queue, back into the race.
You never know what's coming next,
Another call waiting, another new mess.

lyrics.name: DROP
lyrics.note: Savage distorted square-wave bass, double-time drums

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: Another bloody headset doing in my head!
Customer wants answers, fair enough, mate,
But don't shoot the bloke who's trying to help today!
South West massive, holding the line,
Penzance to Cheltenham, voices on the phone,
A hundred different stories, none of them their own.
Some of these calls leave a proper deep scar.
Not asking for medals, not asking for fame,
Just a bit more respect for the weight of the game.

lyrics.name: Pause
lines: And then there's the fucking payslip.

lyrics.name: FINAL DROP
lyrics.note: Crushing distorted 808, aggressive icy Eskimo bass

lyrics.name: Long silence
lines: Customer services, how can I help?

artworkAlt: CSC — Hold The Line: the hooded Planner FM MC wearing a headset at a neon-lit customer services desk, surrounded by incoming calls, case notes and a stormy Cornish coast.
sleeveNote: One number. A hundred different stories. Big up the CSC crew holding the line, one call at a time.

Bang Bang Club, bass shaking the floor,

title: Emma: North Side Signal
subtitle: North side covered. Passport ready.

lyrics.name: Intro

Between the two of 'em, there's fuck-all they can't repair!
Well, not with a hammer, not with a drill,
Just a screen and a phone and a serious bit of skill!
Blonde hair shining, got that holiday glow,
Where's she off next? Nobody fucking knows!
One minute planning, next minute Spain,
Then she's back at her desk doing it all again!

lyrics.name: HOOK

Got her little girl, that's a different class.
Mum when she's home, planner through the day,
A whole bloody life outside the nine-to-five way!
Amanda next door, two legends in line,
One's looking at holidays, one's thinking house time!
One's got snake stories from the Spanish sun,
The other's planning where she's going for the next one!

lyrics.name: Verse 3

title: Practically Perfect (For Michelle)
subtitle: Bonus track. For my better half.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Gentle fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft vinyl crackle

lyrics.name: Spoken
lines: And that's putting it fucking lightly.

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: She's a nurse by trade, got a heart that gives,
Spends her days helping strangers live.
Then she comes home, another shift begins,
Two little faces with their cheeky grins.
Our boy's six, got a heart made of gold,
Full of mischief, impossible to control.
Little girl's three, an angel in sight,
But she's never understood sleeping through the night.
And there she is, through the noise and the mess,
Finding little bits of magic in the everyday stress.
I look at this woman, and what can I say?
She makes the world better in her own little way.

lyrics.name: Chorus
lyrics.note: Warm melodic male vocals, gentle layered harmonies
lines: Oh Michelle, you're the light in our days,
You turn all of our chaos into beautiful ways.
No magic umbrella, no flying away,
Just practically perfect in every way.
Oh Michelle, when the world gets too loud,
You're the one that brings me back to solid ground.
Through the laughter, the tears and the grey,
You're practically perfect in every way.

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Beautiful acoustic guitar riff, deep warm bass

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Now Mary Poppins had a trick or two,
But she'd last one bedtime, then she'd hand it to you!
A spoonful of sugar? Yeah, that's all well and good,
Try raising our two in this neighbourhood!
And I know there are days when you're tired to the bone,
When you've given so much, there's not much left of your own.
So when the world gets heavy, let me carry some too,
'Cause there's no one on earth I'd rather stand beside than you.
You're clever, you're gorgeous, you're funny as hell,
And there's a million little stories I could never quite tell.
Not some fairytale princess, no Hollywood scene,
Just the most incredible woman I've ever seen.

lyrics.name: Soft spoken rap
lines: And I know I don't say it
But you gave me a family,
And you made this life good.
But because I get to face it

lyrics.name: Final Chorus
lines: Oh Michelle, you're the light in our days,
You turn all of our chaos into beautiful ways.
No magic umbrella, no flying away,
Just practically perfect in every way.
Oh Michelle, there's one thing I know,
Through every little storm and wherever we go.
Of all the things that life could ever give me,
Nothing comes close to our little family.

lyrics.name: Outro
lyrics.note: Soft acoustic guitar, intimate spoken voice

artworkAlt: Practically Perfect sleeve: Michelle and her partner sit close together on a coastal bench in warm sunset light.
sleeveNote: After all the noise, this one’s for Michelle. My better half. Practically perfect in every way.
